description: This Java source file defines the ResourceLoader class, which models an XML element <resource-loader> used in the entity configuration context within the OFBiz framework. It provides constructor methods to parse XML attributes and getter methods to access property values.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: A final class representing a resource loader element in entity configurations, with attributes such as name, className, prependEnv, and prefix, which are initialized from an XML Element.

methods.name: ResourceLoader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ResourceLoader instance by parsing attributes from an XML Element, throwing exceptions if mandatory attributes are empty.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the 'name' attribute value of the resource loader.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the 'class' attribute value of the resource loader.

methods.name: getPrependEnv
methods.description: Returns the 'prepend-env' attribute value of the resource loader.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the 'prefix' attribute value of the resource loader.
